title: Vibe Coders: Stop Ignoring Hosting Costs
description:
Comment "HOST" and I'll DM you the full breakdown.

There's a hidden bandwidth tax on your app, and most vibe coders find out the hard way. The math:

1. Vercel Pro: $20 per seat + metered bandwidth ($0.15/GB over 1TB)
2. One viral moment or image-heavy page = a surprise bill in the hundreds
3. Cloudflare Workers: flat $5/month, and $0 for bandwidth, ever
4. A real app that runs ~$305/mo on Vercel runs ~$15 on Cloudflare. Same traffic.

You don't migrate everything day one. New projects and high-traffic APIs first.

Comment "HOST" and I'll DM you the breakdown.

#vibecoding #buildinpublic #webdev #saas #indiehackers
